 Bleeding Green Nation Notifications Notifications The Feed 1 1stand12 1d The NFC East is begging us to get back in the race 
 With the Giants and Cowboys losing over the past few days, as improbable as it sounds, the NFC East is still wide open.
 The Giants play the following teams to finish the season: Jaguars, Colts, 49ers, Seahawks, Browns, Lions, Cowboys, and Eagles.
 Cowboys play the following teams: Titans, Eagles, Seahawks, Rams, Jaguars, Giants, and Commanders.
 Commanders play the following teams: Bengals, Cardinals, Titans, Texans, Falcons, Vikings, Jaguars, Cowboys.
 We play the following teams: Steelers, Cowboys, Cardinals, Colts, Seahawks, Texans, 49ers, and Giants.
 I know this sounds absurd on the face of it. But if we can actually get our top guys back healthy after the bye week and beat the Steelers…I actually think it becomes game on. Because I do not see many more wins for our NFC East rivals outside of playing each other. If we lose to the Steelers it’s pretty much a wrap. But if we can get a win against the Steelers I think things can change very quickly.
